# IPGeolocation.io

IPGeolocation.io provides IP geolocation, threat intelligence, ASN, abuse contact, timezone, User-Agent, and astronomy data.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ipgeolocation/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Look Up IP Geolocation** (read-only): Return geolocation results for 1-50 explicit IP addresses or domains in one paid request, preserving input order and per-item errors.
- **Bulk Look Up IP Security** (read-only): Return threat intelligence for 1-50 IPv4 or IPv6 addresses in one paid request, preserving order and per-item errors.
- **Bulk Parse User-Agents** (read-only): Parse 1-50 custom User-Agent strings in one paid request and return one ordered parser result per input.
- **Convert Timezone** (read-only): Convert a supplied or current wall-clock time between two explicit timezone, place, coordinate, airport-code, or UN/LOCODE selectors of…
- **Get Execution Egress IP** (read-only): Return the public IP observed for the Composio execution environment.
- **Look Up ASN** (read-only): Return detailed autonomous-system metadata for one explicit IP address or ASN number, with optional topology, routes, and WHOIS data.
- **Look Up Astronomy** (read-only): Return Sun, Moon, twilight, golden-hour, and positional data for one explicit location and date.
- **Look Up Astronomy Time Series** (read-only): Return daily Sun, Moon, twilight, and golden-hour events for one explicit location over an inclusive range of at most 90 days.
- **Look Up IP Abuse Contact** (read-only): Return registry abuse contact details for one explicit IPv4 or IPv6 address, including organization, address, emails, and phone numbers.
- **Look Up IP Geolocation** (read-only): Return location, timezone, currency, ASN, and optional paid enrichments for one explicit IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or domain.
- **Look Up IP Security** (read-only): Return threat score and Tor, proxy, VPN, relay, bot, spam, attacker, and cloud-provider signals for one explicit IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- **Look Up Timezone** (read-only): Return current date, time, UTC offsets, and DST details for one explicit timezone, place, coordinate pair, IP, airport code, or UN/LOCODE.
- **Parse User-Agent** (read-only): Parse one explicit User-Agent string using the operation available on the free plan.
